items.summary: Recommendation: preserve all three CRO control-plane specifications as deferred backlog, but do not create proposals or implementation requests during containment. Evidence: 187 approved proposals lack execution, 9 implementation requests failed with 47 repair follow-ups open, 28 improvements await measurement, and only 2 are proven. Unknown: expected reduction in backlog and engineering effort are not yet calculable. Smallest next step: complete existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, and legal/security evidence; then prototype the highest-value workflow. Owner decision: keep the current containment-only disposition or authorize a bounded control-plane prototype.

Handoff: retain the approval-to-execution reconciliation, failure-aware queue lifecycle, and measurement-readiness gate as evidence-backed deferred work. Do not create duplicate proposals, site changes, requeues, telemetry, dependencies, spend, or deployments until containment gates clear.
